WireMarking.description:
Wire marking rules of a view (UEP-0001 §3.5.1). The current format marks the conductors of the cables of the
power tree (``node.cable``); format 2.0 extends the same rules to ``wires[]``.

ext.description: Free-form extensions, namespaced by vendor prefix (e.g. {'acme': {...}}). Tools must preserve what they do not understand.
ext.title: Ext

scheme.description: 'manual': only the marks written in the document (cable 'marks'); 'potential': one number per potential (net), shared by its conductors; 'sequential': one number per conductor; 'pattern': marks built from 'pattern'
scheme.title: Scheme

pattern.description: Template of the 'pattern' scheme, e.g. '{circuit}-{conductor}'. Tokens: {circuit}, {conductor}, {ref} (tag of the 'from' device), {from}, {to} (tags of the two ends), {cable} (cable tag), {n} (sequence number); {from_port}, {to_port}, {potential}, {strip}, {terminal} are reserved for format 2.0 and empty in the current format
pattern.title: Pattern

per.description: Numbering restarts per 'document', 'sheet' or 'enclosure' (of the 'from' end)
per.title: Per

power.description: Power conductors in the 'potential' and 'sequential' schemes: 'conductor' marks them with their conductor (L1, N, PE), 'number' numbers them, 'none' leaves them unmarked
power.title: Power

keep_manual.description: Marks written in the document are kept; generated numbers skip the values they use
keep_manual.title: Keep Manual

order.description: Numbering order: 'layout' (sheet, then column, then top to bottom) or 'document' (order of the tree)
order.title: Order
